verdict.rationale: PayPal's first-party docs show in-assistant checkout for ChatGPT through ACP (an MCP server with complete_checkout plus Instant Checkout) and for Google AI Mode/Gemini through UCP with Braintree, and Store Sync lets agents complete purchases through conversational interfaces. Several limits apply: the ChatGPT and Gemini paths require a Braintree account, access is form-gated, Google enablement is gated, and Store Sync covers only US physical goods in USD. missing for 10: any evidence of checkout in Claude, Copilot or peer assistants, self-serve access for non-Braintree merchants, support for digital goods, subscriptions or non-US buyers, and independent or hands-on confirmation of live in-chat purchases.

support.subject: As a merchant, buyers can complete purchases of my products inside chat and assistant surfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and peers)

citations.quote: Agent Ready helps Braintree merchants accept payments from AI shopping assistants across major platforms, including ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, and Gemini, without building separate integrations for each.
Use this guide to build a custom ChatGPT app that accepts payments using the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) and the ChatGPT Apps SDK.
This enables AI-powered checkout experiences through Google AI Mode (Gemini)
enabling AI agents to discover your products, create and manage shopping carts, and complete purchases on behalf of customers through conversational interfaces
Store Sync currently supports merchants who are selling physical goods to US-based customers in USD.
